home.supplierText: {companyName} works with industrial and agricultural machinery, supplying original {partner} hydraulic equipment and providing service support at every stage — from component selection to installation and maintenance.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Full-cycle work with hydraulic equipment — from selection to service.
services.card1Text: Direct supply of {partner} pumps, hydraulic cylinders, PTO and valves for your project and timeline.
services.card2Text: We help you choose the right hydraulics for your specific machine and task — by parameters or by sample.
services.card3Text: We install and configure hydraulic systems at the customer's site or in our own workshop.
services.card4Text: Diagnostics, repair and restoration of pumps and hydraulic cylinders, seal and repair kit replacement.
services.card5Text: Original spare parts and consumables for {partner} equipment, in stock and to order.
services.card6Text: Technical consulting on the operation and maintenance of hydraulic equipment.

about.title: About the company
about.intro: {companyName} has been operating in the Moldovan market since {founded}. We sell auto parts and hydraulic systems, and also provide auto service. The company is the official partner of the Turkish hydraulic equipment manufacturer {partner}, operating since 1988. We supply pumps, hydraulic cylinders, power take-offs (PTO), hydraulic valves and related components for industrial, construction and agricultural machinery.
